not_eligible.text: Based on the information provided, you do not currently appear to meet one or more core Italy Elective Residence Visa requirements.

no_work_in_italy_not_confirmed.text: Italy's Elective Residence Visa is a passive-income / no-work residence visa. Based on the information provided, this pathway does not appear to match plans involving work in Italy.

extended_tourism_purpose.text: Italy's Elective Residence Visa is for stable residence in Italy, not extended tourism. Based on the information provided, this pathway does not appear to match the stated residence purpose.

insufficient_passive_income.text: Based on the passive income provided, you do not currently appear to meet the Italy Elective Residence Visa financial threshold.

employment_or_work_income_not_accepted.text: Italy's Elective Residence Visa must be supported by passive or private income. Based on the information provided, employment or active work income does not appear to satisfy this pathway.

qualifying_italian_lodging_unavailable.text: Italy's Elective Residence Visa requires qualifying lodging in Italy, such as a registered lease, rental contract, or property deed. Without qualifying lodging, eligibility cannot be confirmed.

health_insurance_unavailable.text: Italy's Elective Residence Visa requires health insurance valid in Italy covering medical care and hospitalization for the full stay. Without qualifying coverage, eligibility cannot be confirmed.

passport_validity_below_minimum.text: Based on the passport validity provided, you do not currently appear to meet the baseline passport-validity requirement for Italy's Elective Residence Visa.

passport_issued_too_old_for_paris.text: For a Paris filing, the passport must have been issued within the previous 10 years. Based on the information provided, that jurisdiction-specific requirement is not currently met.

adult_child_dependency_not_met.text: Based on the family details provided, an included dependent adult child does not appear to satisfy the dependency requirement for the Italy Elective Residence family route.

text: Your answers need manual review before Italy Elective Residence Visa eligibility can be confirmed.
The team should follow up by email with next steps or any follow-up questions.
You do not currently appear to meet one or more mandatory Italy Elective Residence Visa qualification requirements.

If your passive income, financial assets, no-work plan, Italian lodging, insurance, passport validity, or family route changes, you can complete the eligibility check again or ask the team about alternative Italy pathways.
Your applicant route needs manual review.
The team should confirm whether you are applying individually or with family dependents.
Your Italian consulate jurisdiction needs manual review.
The team should identify the filing consulate because passport and lodging requirements can vary by jurisdiction.
Your no-work residence plan needs manual review.
The team should confirm that your Italy Elective Residence case is funded by passive or private income and does not involve working in Italy.
Your passive income is at the reference threshold and needs manual review.
The team should evaluate whether your income and assets are strong enough for the relevant consulate's discretionary financial review.
Your financial assets need manual review.
The team should verify whether your available assets, together with passive income, support a stable residence case.
Your passive income source needs manual review.
The team should verify whether your income comes from accepted private sources such as pensions, Social Security, annuities, property income, investments, trusts, or stable commercial activity.
Your Italy lodging evidence needs manual review.
The team should verify whether hotels or short-term bookings are acceptable for your filing jurisdiction, or whether a registered lease, rental contract, or deed is required.
Your health insurance status needs manual review.
The team should verify whether you can provide medical and hospitalization coverage valid in Italy for the full stay.
Your passport validity needs manual review for a San Francisco filing.
The team should confirm whether the 15-month passport-validity threshold applies before preparing the application.
Your passport issue date needs manual review for a Paris filing.
The team should confirm whether the 10-year passport-issuance rule is satisfied.
Your adult-child dependency details need manual review.
The team should verify whether an included adult child lives with and depends financially on the parent applicant.
Your understanding of the 8-day permesso di soggiorno filing requirement needs review.
The team will confirm this post-entry compliance step during application preparation.
